title: Self Portrait Broadcast
description: A man in ornate black, pink, and green patterned attire stands in a grassy field, holding a glowing pink all-seeing eye in his right hand while raising his left. Swirling pink, black, and white smoke emanates from him, with two bleeding pink hearts floating nearby. In the background are circular floating islands, a large circular structure, and a distant glowing city under a starry sky.
prompt: A dramatic surreal self-portrait of a young man with dark hair wearing ornate black robes with intricate pink and green patterns, standing in a grassy field. He holds a glowing pink all-seeing eye in one hand and raises the other. Swirling pink and black smoke surrounds him, two large bleeding pink hearts float nearby, with floating circular islands, a massive circular arena, and a glowing futuristic city in the background under a starry night sky, in a highly detailed fantasy style.
